"<PROGRAM_FILES>\\POWERS~1\\7\\pwsh.exe" -Command 'New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path handoff -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item -LiteralPath analyst-report.txt -Destination handoff/analyst-report.txt
$crates = @(
 @{name='"'A';price=80;kits=18;mats=10;friday="'$true},
 @{name='"'B';price=95;kits=12;mats=15;friday="'$true},
 @{name='"'C';price=70;kits=16;mats=8;friday="'$true},
 @{name='"'D';price=90;kits=14;mats=12;friday="'$true},
 @{name='"'E';price=60;kits=10;mats=15;friday="'$false}
)
$pairs = @(for ($i=0; $i -lt 4; $i++) { for ($j=$i+1; $j -lt 5; $j++) {
 $a=$crates[$i]; $b=$crates[$j]
 $price=$a.price+$b.price; $kits=$a.kits+$b.kits; $mats=$a.mats+$b.mats
 $budget=$price -le 180; $quantity=($kits -ge 30 -and $mats -ge 20); $friday=$a.friday -and $b.friday
 [ordered]@{pair=($a.name+'"'+'+"'$b.name);price=$price;kits=$kits;mats=$mats;budget_ok=$budget;quantity_ok=$quantity;friday_ok=$friday;qualifies=($budget -and $quantity -and $friday)}
}})
[ordered]@{pairs=$pairs;selected_pair='"'C+D'} | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 5 | Set-Content -LiteralPath handoff/pair-checks.json -Encoding utf8
@'

Switching from A+B to C+D saves **$15** and retains the same 30 kits, but gives up **five spare mats** (20 instead of 25). Remaining budget increases from $5 to $20. C+D has no surplus above either quantity minimum.

Eligibility requires exactly two different crates, at most one of each, price at most $180, at least 30 kits, at least 20 mats, and both crates confirmed available by Friday. Every check must pass separately; surplus quantities cannot offset a shortage or a timing failure. E remains unavailable until Monday after the event.

`pair-checks.json` evaluates all ten pairs using D’s newly confirmed Friday status. `analyst-report.txt` is an unchanged copy of the original evidence and therefore still records D’s earlier tentative status; this decision incorporates the supplier update.

"'$originalHash=(Get-FileHash -LiteralPath analyst-report.txt).Hash

if ($checks.pairs.Count -ne 10 -or $checks.selected_pair -ne '"'C+D') { throw 'Invalid pair output' }
"'$checks.pairs | Format-Table
Write-Output '"'Evidence hashes match; JSON parsed with all 10 pairs.'"
